why_seated: ALEXANDER IN JUDAEA. Yoma 69a: the Samaritans ask Alexander of Macedon for the Temple, and Simeon the Righteous goes out to meet him in the priestly garments, the rabbinic telling of Josephus, AJ 11.317–347 (seated) with Jaddua. Megillat Ta'anit 21 Kislev, "the day of Mount Gerizim", carries the same story in its scholion; its Tevet entry names King Yannai and Queen Shalminon, the Alexander and his wife of AJ 14.10.

research.study: the evening of 2026-11-20: the Cicero and Sulla paste, the wills, Alexander, Antipater and Judaea, Theophrastus's On Kingship, the Clouds against the treatises, and The Thinkery and the Lyceum (groundwork note, draft v0.1)
research.for: the one-corpus premise (Plato, Aristotle and Theophrastus as one corpus in two transmission streams) and the relations it was read against: the impiety charges, the Macedonian patronage of the school, the Alexander traditions of Judaea, and the comic and tragic stage the King Archon administered
